data.body:
In purescript argonaut `Json` represents a type which covers a specific set of constructors which cover specific set of types.
This library constructs `Json` values which contain `BigInt` which violates the `Json` invariant (for example this function is broken and gonna throw runtime error: https://github.com/purescript-contrib/purescript-argonaut-core/blob/main/src/Data/Argonaut/Core.purs#L73).
I propose an introduction of another type (like `BigIntJson`) and separate set of type classes (`EncodeBigIntJson`, `DecodeBigIntJson`) to preserve correctness and drop the hidden global `JSON` patching requirement.
data.title: Introduce `BigIntJson` type wrapper to indicate that we cover `BigInt` values in our JSON

data.body:
This PR fixes a decoding issue that was solved for Core but not for Extended Marlowe.

To try the problem run 

```
[nix-shell] $ npm run run-spec
```

and then enter the following json

```json
{
    "request": "test-roundtrip-serialization",
    "typeId": "Extended.Value",
    "json": {"add": 100000000000000000000000000, "and": 30000000000}
}
```

Before the fix it throws a runtime error, after the fix it returns the json roundtrip.
data.title: Fix extended value json decode
